title: Graphs of Quasicircles and Quasiconformal Homeomorphisms
summary: We give a combinatorial characterization of the group of quasiconformal homeomorphisms of a closed, oriented surface $S$ of genus at least $2$. In particular, we prove they are exactly the automorphisms of a graph of essential quasicircles on $S$ that respect a canonical coarse ordering induced by quality constants. We also discuss the coarse geometry of this graph.
